disclaimer: Site coordinates are approximate reference points, not survey-grade archaeological geometries. No raw LiDAR data or reconstructed buildings are included.

sites.name: Angkor Wat
sites.summary: A monumental temple complex commissioned under Suryavarman II. The structure is directly documented; the broader inhabited enclosure is understood through archaeological investigation.

sites.name: Bayon
sites.summary: A major temple at the center of Angkor Thom. Its surviving masonry is documented, while interpretations of the surrounding ancient population depend on broader archaeological evidence.

sites.name: Ta Prohm
sites.summary: A temple complex associated with Jayavarman VII. The surviving ruins are documented and form part of the Angkor World Heritage landscape.

records.title: Surviving temple complex
records.statement: Angkor Wat is a standing, extensively studied stone monument included in the UNESCO World Heritage property of Angkor.
records.uncertainty: This is a monument-level reference location, not a surveyed outline of every archaeological feature.
records.confidenceBasis: Standing monument and inclusion in the officially documented Angkor heritage landscape.

records.title: Standing temple remains
records.statement: Bayon is a documented temple at the center of Angkor Thom, recognized as part of the Angkor archaeological landscape.
records.uncertainty: The point is a reference location, not a measured building footprint.
records.confidenceBasis: Standing monument and inclusion in the officially documented Angkor heritage landscape.

records.title: Standing temple remains
records.statement: Ta Prohm's surviving temple structures are documented and included in the wider Angkor World Heritage property.
records.uncertainty: No detailed geometric survey or architectural model is supplied by this prototype.
records.confidenceBasis: Standing monument and inclusion in the officially documented Angkor heritage landscape.

records.title: Urban blocks, mounds and ponds
records.statement: The 2012 airborne LiDAR survey was interpreted as showing a regular grid of occupation mounds and excavated ponds within Angkor Wat's moated enclosure.
records.uncertainty: LiDAR detects surface topography. It does not reveal exact houses or establish the use of every mound.
records.confidenceBasis: Supported by published landscape-scale interpretations; the record does not map a particular house or earthwork.

records.title: Wider planned urban landscape
records.statement: Research places Angkor Thom and its monumental center within a larger engineered and inhabited landscape, rather than an isolated temple precinct.
records.uncertainty: This is an area-wide research interpretation. The Bayon marker does not indicate the footprint of the broader settlement.
records.confidenceBasis: Supported by published landscape-scale interpretations; the record does not map a particular house or earthwork.

records.title: Possible timber-dwelling model
records.statement: A future 3D layer might illustrate a plausible wooden dwelling, informed by published archaeological and historical work. This is only a design proposal; no dwelling has been placed in the map.
records.uncertainty: Building design, ownership, orientation and exact placement remain unverified here. Do not treat this concept as a discovered structure.
records.confidenceBasis: A future design concept rather than an archaeological identification.
